transfer.question: Does it work on a new network?
transfer.label: of attack flows caught after moving 2017 → 2018
transfer.tip: Trained on one corrected CIC dataset, tested on the other (LGBM, all 83 shared features). Bars show attack recall; macro F1 over the 12 common classes: 2017→2017 0.89, 2017→2018 0.58, 2018→2017 0.34, 2018→2018 0.95. Dropping environment-specific features (port, TCP windows) did not help. Source: docs/results/cross_dataset.md Calibrating on 1,000 local benign flows cuts false alarms from 3.4% to 1.2% but class-balanced detection falls from 55% to 32%: calibration controls alert burden, not detection. Source: docs/results/local_calibration.md

stability.question: Do explanations stay the same?
stability.label: median top-5 SHAP overlap across 5 training seeds
stability.tip: Same 500 test attack flows explained by models trained with different seeds; overlap 1 = identical top-5 features, 0 = none shared (0.67 = 4 of 5 shared). 0 of 5,000 flow pairs skipped because the prediction changed. Source: docs/results/shap_stability_cicids2017.md

unseen.question: Can it catch attacks it never saw?
unseen.label: median detection of an unseen attack type
unseen.tip: Each attack class removed from training in turn (cicids2017, 14 classes); bars show how much of it still raised an alert. Isolation Forest threshold set for 1% false alarms on validation benign traffic. With signed-log features for the Isolation Forest the median is 57%. On csecicids2018 the median is 7%. Source: docs/results/unseen_cicids2017.md
